AI Notes.value: Poplar Studio is a London-based AR and 3D product visualisation platform, founded 2018 by David Ripert (ex-YouTube/Google EMEA head) and Laurie Ainley. The company converts product photography into 3D models and deploys AR try-on and in-environment viewers across web, Shopify, social and the metaverse. Clients include L'Oreal, Disney, Speedo, Universal Music, and Jack Daniels; 1,600+ certified 3D/AR creators in their network.
